Sections.Name: QualityGeneration
Sections.Description: Choose which weapon variants are generated and exclude selected types or weapons.

Properties.Description: Choose which weapon variant quality tiers are generated. Disable a tier only if your profile contains no weapon variants of that quality.
Variant type names to exclude from generation, such as "Meta" or "SMG". Exclude only types whose weapon variants are absent from your profile.
Weapon variant short names to exclude from generation, such as "AKM Meta". Exclude only weapon variants that are absent from your profile.

Sections.Name: QualityWeights
Sections.Description: Set relative quality weights for random selections.

Properties.Description: Relative weights used when selecting a quality tier for loot and other random rewards. Higher values make a tier more likely; these values are not percentages.

Sections.Name: LootSources1
Sections.DisplayName: Loot Sources - Airdrops, Fence and Flea Market
Sections.Description: Choose which variant quality tiers can appear in airdrops, at Fence and on the flea market.

Properties.Description: Choose which variant quality tiers can appear in airdrops.
Choose which variant quality tiers can appear in Fence's stock. Some variants may lack required special attachments that cannot be bought separately.
Choose which variant quality tiers can be bought or sold on the flea market.

Sections.Name: LootSources2
Sections.DisplayName: Loot Sources - Marked Rooms and Containers
Sections.Description: Choose eligible quality tiers and spawn probabilities for marked rooms and loot containers.

Properties.Description: Choose which variant quality tiers can spawn in marked rooms.

Properties.DisplayName: Variant Chance per Marked-Room Spawn Point
Properties.Description: Chance of a weapon variant spawning at each marked-room spawn point. Use a fraction: 0.30 = 30%; 0 disables these spawns.
Choose which variant quality tiers can spawn in supported loot containers.
Chance of a weapon variant spawning in each supported loot container. Use a fraction: 0.30 = 30%; 0 disables these spawns.

Sections.Name: Trader
Sections.Description: Configure Merchant's rotating stock and special ammunition trade.

Properties.Description: Number of different weapon variant offers in Merchant's rotating stock per refresh. Set to 0 to disable rotating weapon variant offers.
Range, in seconds, from which Merchant's stock refresh interval is selected. Minimum must be less than or equal to maximum.
Shortest interval between stock refreshes. Must be less than or equal to the maximum interval.
Longest interval between stock refreshes. Must be greater than or equal to the minimum interval.
Make 12.7x108mm B-32 ammunition available to buy from Merchant.
Configure the ammunition trade at Merchant. Set the required loyalty level to 0 to disable this trade.
Merchant loyalty level required for this trade (1-4). Set to 0 to disable the trade.

Items required for one purchase. Keys are item identifiers, such as "MONEY_ROUBLES" or "Baseline Quality Variant Core"; values are the required quantities. Multiple entries are required together for the same trade.

Sections.Name: VariantCoresGeneral
Sections.Description: Configure weapon core slots, base core prices and slot requirements. Core items and trades are independent of the slot toggle.

Properties.DisplayName: Add Variant Core Slots to Weapons
Properties.Description: Add a mod_core slot to weapon variants and install a matching Normal Core in their presets. Disabling this only removes the weapon slot; cores, Unknown Packages, trades and bot pocket loot remain available.
Base price in roubles for each core quality. Used to calculate the prices of cores and related items.

Require an installed Variant Core for a weapon variant to function. When enabled, cores cannot normally be removed during a raid. The UI Fixes mod can allow removal with "Modify Weapons In Raid" set to "Always" or "With Multitool". This setting also addresses missing cores on weapon variants equipped by APBS bots. Applies only when ModCoreSlotEnabled is enabled.

Sections.Name: VariantCoresNormal
Sections.Description: Configure Normal Core bonuses, purchases, quality upgrades and bot loot.

Properties.Description: Ergonomics points added to the weapon while a Normal Core is installed.
Allow Normal Cores to be bought from Merchant.

Configure Normal Core purchases at Merchant. The rouble price is the base price for that quality multiplied by the Normal Core price multiplier. Set the required loyalty level to 0 to disable these trades.
Merchant loyalty level required for this trade (1-4). Set to 0 to disable the trade.
Make Merchant's stock of this item unlimited.
Number of this item stocked for each trader refresh. Ignored when unlimited stock is enabled.
Allow lower-quality Normal Cores to be exchanged at Merchant for Normal Cores of the next quality tier.
Highest quality obtainable through Normal Core upgrades. For example, "Baseline" allows Meme -> Flawed -> Baseline.
Number of Normal Cores of the previous quality tier required to obtain one Normal Core of the next tier.
Configure Normal Core quality upgrade trades at Merchant. Set the required loyalty level to 0 to disable these trades.
Merchant loyalty level required for this trade (1-4). Set to 0 to disable the trade.
Make Merchant's stock of this item unlimited.
Number of this item stocked for each trader refresh. Ignored when unlimited stock is enabled.

Properties.DisplayName: Core Spawn Chance by Bot Type
Properties.Description: Chance of a Normal Core spawning in a bot's pockets, keyed by the internal bot type name, such as "assault". Use a fraction: 0.33 = 33%. Set all entries to 0 to disable these spawns.
Multiplier applied to the base core price for each quality to calculate the Normal Core price.

Sections.Name: VariantCoresLocked
Sections.Description: Configure Locked Core bonuses and exchanges from Normal Cores.

Properties.Description: Ergonomics points added to the weapon while a Locked Core is installed.
Accuracy bonus applied to the weapon while a Locked Core is installed.
Number of Normal Cores required to obtain one Locked Core of the same quality.
Configure Normal-to-Locked Core exchanges at Merchant. Set the required loyalty level to 0 to disable these exchanges.
Merchant loyalty level required for this trade (1-4). Set to 0 to disable the trade.
Make Merchant's stock of this item unlimited.
Number of this item stocked for each trader refresh. Ignored when unlimited stock is enabled.
Multiplier applied to the base core price for each quality to calculate the Locked Core price.

Sections.Name: UnknownPackage
Sections.Description: Configure packages that contain random Variant Cores.

Properties.Description: Allow Unknown Packages to appear in supported loot containers and in Merchant's stock. Packages and their cores remain available when weapon core slots are disabled.
Inventory dimensions in cells and weight in kilograms for an Unknown Package.
Item width in inventory cells.
Item height in inventory cells.
Item weight in kilograms.
Configure Unknown Package purchases at Merchant. Set the required loyalty level to 0 to disable this trade.
Merchant loyalty level required for this trade (1-4). Set to 0 to disable the trade.
Make Merchant's stock of this item unlimited.
Number of this item stocked for each trader refresh. Ignored when unlimited stock is enabled.

Items required for one purchase. Keys are item identifiers, such as "MONEY_ROUBLES" or "Baseline Quality Variant Core"; values are the required quantities. Multiple entries are required together for the same trade.
Number of cores received when opening one Unknown Package.
Chance of an Unknown Package spawning in each supported loot container. Use a fraction: 0.33 = 33%; 0 disables these spawns.

Sections.Name: VariantCoresUniversal
Sections.Description: Configure the relative chance of receiving Universal Cores from Unknown Packages.

Properties.Description: Relative weight of all Universal Cores combined compared with all Unique-quality cores combined in Unknown Packages. A value of 1 gives equal total weights; 2 makes Universal Cores twice as likely as Unique-quality cores. This is not an absolute drop percentage.

Sections.Name: BlindBoxes
Sections.Description: Configure boxes that contain a random weapon variant of the same quality.

Properties.Description: Add weapon cases that each contain one random weapon variant of the same quality as the box.
Inventory dimensions in cells and weight in kilograms for a weapon blind box.
Item width in inventory cells.
Item height in inventory cells.
Item weight in kilograms.
Number of Normal Cores required to buy one blind box of the same quality.
Configure blind box purchases at Merchant. Set the required loyalty level to 0 to disable these trades.
Merchant loyalty level required for this trade (1-4). Set to 0 to disable the trade.
Make Merchant's stock of this item unlimited.
Number of this item stocked for each trader refresh. Ignored when unlimited stock is enabled.
Multiplier applied to the base core price for each quality to calculate the blind box handbook price in roubles.

Sections.Name: ExpeditionaryCase
Sections.Description: Configure the case's inventory size, storage and Merchant trade.

Properties.Description: Internal storage dimensions, in cells, for each core quality in the Expeditionary Case.
Number of horizontal storage cells for each core quality.
Number of vertical storage cells for each core quality.
Inventory dimensions in cells and weight in kilograms for the Expeditionary Case.

Item height in inventory cells.

Sections.Name: IntegrationsAPBS
Sections.Description: Configure compatibility with Acid's Progressive Bot System (APBS), quality-tier blacklists and timed weapon rotation.

Properties.Description: Automatically create and update APBS blacklists to apply the minimum quality tiers configured below.
Name of the installed APBS mod folder. Change this only if your APBS installation uses a different folder name.

Minimum APBS bot tier at which each variant quality can appear (1-7); 0 excludes that quality entirely. Minimum tiers 1-7 are applied when APBS blacklist generation is enabled. Quality exclusions set to 0 also apply during weapon rotation.
Variant type names to exclude from APBS bots. Keep "Rifle Grenade Launcher" excluded because these variants can cause bot issues. These exclusions also apply during weapon rotation.

Rotate the weapon variants available to APBS bots by temporarily blacklisting variants outside the selected pool. Reducing the number of available variants gives other weapons more opportunity to appear. Type exclusions and quality exclusions set to 0 still apply.
Maximum number of eligible weapon variants made available across APBS tiers during each rotation. If fewer eligible variants exist, all are selected. This is a count, not a spawn percentage.
Minimum time between rotations, in minutes. After this interval expires, rotation occurs on the next APBS bot generation or game start request.
Write additional diagnostic messages to the server log.
